main_text.p: dia, vt summus ille orator inquit, quæ vulneribus adhibentur, tam faciunt dolorem, quàm quæ sunt salutaria.
main_text.head: ¶Logomachiæ Dipnosophisticæ cum Tragœdia comparatio.
main_text.p: PAULUS Apostolus, abster-rens Timotheū à superuacaneis con-flictationibus & stultis ac ineruditis quæstionibus, quę disputationum pugnas nunquam finiendas pariunt magis quàm ędificationē[?] Dei quę est per-fidem: fabulis quæcunque sunt eius-modi annumerat, haud dubiè pro-pter summam vanitatem quæ talibus magna ex parte inesse solet. Dum enim homines inflati, mentéque cor-rupti, æmulatione & inuidia, ne aliis cedere videantur, extimulati, conten-tiones fouent, & ad maledicendū pe-tulantia ingeniorum prorumpunt & exultant: alij saniores, commoti tanta rerum indignitate, cum insanietibus insanire & ipsi quodammodo cogun-tur, vt stultis respondeant secundum stultitiam ipsorum, ne nimium sibi

page.notes: The initial P with small-capital "AVLVS" is printed as "PAVLVS" and is given as "PAULUS" under the u/v rule. "ędificationē" is read from a small scan and may be æ; marked [?]. Hyphens at line ends are printed hyphens and are kept. The long s in "eiuf-" is read as "eius". Heading "¶Logomachiæ..." is set in italic and is treated as a level 2 title above the passage.
